name: Invoice extraction + totals check
description: Extracts invoice data, checks that line items add up to the subtotal and that subtotal + tax - discount + shipping equals the total, and alerts #test-alerts in Slack when they don't.

fields.name: invoice_number
fields.description: Invoice number / ID as printed on the document.

fields.name: vendor_name
fields.description: Legal name of the supplier / seller issuing the invoice.

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.description: Issue date of the invoice, ISO-8601.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the invoice amounts (e.g. EUR, USD).

fields.name: line_items
fields.description: Each billed line of the invoice, one row per line.

nested_fields.name: description
nested_fields.description: Description of the product or service.

nested_fields.name: amount
nested_fields.description: Line total before tax, as printed on the line.

fields.name: subtotal
fields.description: Sum before tax (taxable base / net amount), as printed on the invoice.

fields.name: discount_amount
fields.description: Total discount applied at invoice level, as a positive number. 0 if none is shown.

fields.name: shipping_amount
fields.description: Shipping / handling / freight charges. 0 if none is shown.

fields.name: tax_amount
fields.description: Total tax (VAT / IVA / sales tax) amount. 0 if none is shown.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Grand total amount due, including tax.

check.expression: data.subtotal - data.discount_amount + data.shipping_amount + data.tax_amount - data.total <= 0.02 && data.total - (data.subtotal - data.discount_amount + data.shipping_amount + data.tax_amount) <= 0.02

rules.name: Line items sum to subtotal
rules.description: The sum of the 'amount' of every row in line_items must equal subtotal, within 0.02. Compute the sum exactly and fail if it differs.
